name: leaflets
description: Build brand-matched applicant leaflets (explainer pages) for any online or government service, with an optional named voice guide that narrates the page. The brand is matched to a target site you point at (URL or screenshots); the guide's name, man/woman voice, and language are user-chosen. Includes two grounding skills that derive a traced content map by cross-reading the law and the live BPA service: service-concept-brief (per legal-form type, 'what each type IS') and service-journey-brief (per single service, 'what it is and how it works').
